summary: FERC grants the abeyance motions of NYISO, the New York Transmission Owners and the Non-Incumbent Transmission Owners and holds the EL26-69 show cause proceeding for 90 days, moving responses to November 16, 2026 and answers to December 16, 2026.

points.point: FERC grants all three abeyance motions filed August 3 and holds the proceeding for 90 days.
points.quote: we grant the Abeyance Motions filed by NYISO, NYTOs, and Non-Incumbent TOs and hold this proceeding in abeyance for

points.point: NYISO plans a Management Committee vote on October 28 and a section 205 filing on November 16, 2026.
points.quote: with the final proposal presented to the Management Committee on October 28, 2026.

points.point: FERC finds the movants met the order's test of describing the future filing and giving a date.
points.quote: have provided a robust description of the filings they anticipate making, provided a date by which they intend to make such filings, and described the on-going stakeholder process

points.point: New due dates are November 16, 2026 for responses and December 16, 2026 for answers.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 16, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 16, 2026.

points.point: A timely section 205 filing suspends the filer's duty to respond, and the proceeding stays in abeyance.
points.quote: the obligation of the respondent(s) who have made such an FPA section 205 filing to file a response to the Show Cause Order will be suspended

throughLine.text: Moves the E-12 NYISO 60-day show cause response from August 17 to November 16, 2026, using the 90-day abeyance option the June 18 order offered for stakeholder-developed section 205 filings.

figures.label: Abeyance granted for NYISO show cause proceeding
figures.quote: hold this proceeding in abeyance for
